button.name: action_abj_use_as_customer_location
button.string: Save this position as the customer's map location
button.invisible: not partner_id or not has_location or location_status != 'unknown' or state not in ('checked_in', 'done')

button.name: action_abj_use_as_customer_location
button.string: Replace the customer's map location with this position
button.confirm: The customer's saved map location is far from this check-in. Only replace it if this check-in was really at the customer's place. Replace it?
button.invisible: not partner_id or not has_location or location_status != 'far' or state not in ('checked_in', 'done')
